mapper.select: SELECT FROM repair_leave_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_leave_request(worker_id, start_time, end_time, reason, status, reassign_status, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES(#{workerId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{reassignStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM repair_leave_request l JOIN repair_worker w ON w.id = l.worker_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = w.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ra ON ra.id = l.review_admin_id WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.worker_id = #{workerId} AND l.status = #{approvalStatus} ORDER BY l.id DESC

SELECT , l.update_time updateTime FROM repair_leave_request l JOIN repair_worker w ON w.id = l.worker_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = w.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ra ON ra.id = l.review_admin_id WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.id = #{id} AND l.worker_id = #{workerId}

mapper.update: UPDATE repair_leave_request SET reassign_status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND (reassign_status = 0 OR (reassign_status = 1 AND update_time < #{staleBefore}))
